journey.title: The days of Hajj, step by step

0.title: Day of Tarwiyah — Mina
0.subtitle: Enter ihram and travel to Mina, where pilgrims spend the day and night.

1.title: Day of Arafah
1.subtitle: Stand at Arafat in prayer and supplication, then move to Muzdalifah after sunset.

2.title: Day of Sacrifice
2.subtitle: Stone Jamarat al-Aqabah, offer the sacrifice, shave or trim, and perform Tawaf al-Ifadah.

3.title: Days of Tashreeq
3.subtitle: Stay in Mina and stone the three Jamarat, then perform the farewell Tawaf.

0.q: When should I book my Hajj?
0.a: As early as possible. Hajj places are limited each season, so registering early gives you the best chance and more choice of packages.

1.a: Requirements depend on your nationality and country of residence and are set by the official authorities. Our team will tell you exactly what you need and help you prepare it.

2.q: What is included in the price?
2.a: Each package lists its inclusions, typically accommodation, camps in Mina and Arafat, transport between the holy sites and guidance. We confirm every detail before you book.

3.q: Is there support during the days of Hajj?
3.a: Yes. Our team and guides are with you throughout the rites and reachable around the clock.

4.q: Can I book for my family or a group?
4.a: Yes. We arrange programs for families and groups and can help with room and camp arrangements.
